q: Do you like to take public transport?
a:
Yes, I do because it's safe, convenient and reliable. It's also more eco-friendly than driving.

或者：
No, I don't because public transport in my city is inconvenient and unreliable. And it's almost always crowded and uncomfortable.

q: How often do you take a taxi?
a:
I take a taxi at least a few times a week. I usually take a taxi when I'm in a hurry to get somewhere.

或者：
I take a taxi only a few times a year. I take a taxi only when buses are not available.

q: Do you prefer to take a taxi or take the underground?
a:
I prefer to take the underground because it's much cheaper than taking a taxi. It is also more eco-friendly and is a good way to avoid traffic congestion.

或者：
I prefer to take a taxi because the underground tends to be very crowded. A taxi is much more comfortable.

q: What are the advantages of cycling to work or school?
a: The main advantage is that cycling to work or school is eco-friendly and helps us reduce our carbon footprint. Cycling is also cheaper than driving and faster than walking.
vocab: 骑自行车去上班或者上学

q: Do you have a driving licence?
a:
Yes, I do. And I always have my driving licence with me when driving.

或者：
I don't have a driving licence yet. I'm still learning to drive and I'm not confident about my driving skills.

q: Do you like the idea of robots driving our cars?
a: Yes, I do because robots don't get tired like humans. I suppose driving, especially long-distance driving, would be much safer if cars were controlled by robots.
vocab: 自动驾驶的汽车（英国常用）

q: Do you prefer to study alone or with others?
a: I prefer to study alone so that I can concentrate better and think more clearly. Studying with others tends to be distracting.
vocab: 表示目的的连接词，这样就可以……，以便……

q: Do you prefer to study in the morning or in the afternoon?
a: I prefer to study in the morning because I feel refreshed after a good night's sleep. It helps me concentrate better and think more clearly.

q: Are there any skills that you want to learn?
Do you think it's important to learn a foreign language?
a: Definitely. People who have foreign language skills have a competitive edge in the job market. Learning a foreign language can also help us make more friends.

q: Would you like to learn another foreign language?
a: Yes. I'd like to learn French so that I can read French novels in the original and watch French films without having to read the subtitles.
vocab: 直接阅读原文，不需要看译文
